notes: Every component carries K5_INCONCLUSIVE:zeros (all 200 zeros samples UNDEFINED), so WEAK is the best verdict any fixed twin can get.

In B3-05 to B3-12 the brief states the claim through the ratio statistic itself, so the faulty criterion computes the brief's statistic and the fixed criterion a different statistic with the brief's threshold.

class_summary.label: post hoc; does not change the pre-registered result

B-2.notes: All 7 detections attributable; B2-07 fragile (control 20/200 only), B2-05 generic only.

B-3.notes: All 8 detections attributable; for B3-05 only the noise flag (its K2_HIGH_SIZE is shared with the fixed twin); B3-01 rests on the noise probe and a control the faulty twin ignores by construction. B3-09's scored clean pass is not robust.

class_summary.reading: B-2 shortfall mainly a case result: three misses from minus worlds where the leak has little to work with (B2-09, B2-10, B2-12), one from the 60-gene cap (B2-03), one genuine outcome-level limit (B2-06); the failed clean pass is a fixed-criterion design meeting the 0.4.0 abstention rule. B-3 shortfall entirely a case result: four misses are worlds without a shared-denominator artefact (three with a brief that states the claim through the ratio itself), four failed clean passes are corrections that do not test the claim on the declared worlds.
